text:
Fisher Elementary tests only 5th-graders in science MCA for 2024-25
L. O. Perez
The Minnesota Department of Education reports that Fisher Elementary School tested only its fifth-graders in the science portion of the 2024-25 MCA.
All 14 students assessed in the science section at Fisher Elementary were fifth-graders.
The results showed that 7% of fifth-grade students achieved proficiency in science per the assessment standards.
The MCA and Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are state-mandated tests designed to measure progress on Minnesota’s academic standards and comply with legislative requirements. The exams are administered in math, reading, and science, depending on the grade. While most students take the regular MCA, some students in special education who meet eligibility criteria may take the Alt MCA.
Minnesota's Report Card indicates statewide MCA proficiency has fallen since before the pandemic. Math proficiency declined by more than 7% from 2019, and reading proficiency dropped by almost 5%.
Data for this article was sourced from the Minnesota Department of Education. Additional information can be located here.
